import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000

open scoped Topology

theorem joint_projection_isOpenMap {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
  (π₁ : X × Y → X)
  (π₂ : X × Y → Y)
  (h₁ : π₁ = Prod.fst)
  (h₂ : π₂ = Prod.snd) :
  IsOpenMap (fun p : X × Y => (π₁ p, π₂ p)) := by
  subst π₁
  subst π₂
  change ∀ U : Set (X × Y), IsOpen U →
    IsOpen ((fun p : X × Y => (p.1, p.2)) '' U)
  intro U hU
  have h_image : (fun p : X × Y => (p.1, p.2)) '' U = U := by
    ext p
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩
      simpa using hq
    · intro hp
      exact ⟨p, hp, by simp⟩
  rw [h_image]
  exact hU
